findings.title: Stray closing inside {{#each}} loop with no matching opener
findings.body:
The template contains a `` tag on line 19 inside the `{{#each m in members}}` block, but there is no corresponding opening `
` anywhere in the file (the only tag inside the loop is the ``). This produces invalid HTML and will cause the browser to insert an implicit `
` and may misrender rows in the group members table. The line should be removed.

findings.title: delete/put "members" are member routes, but controller reads params[:group_id]
findings.body: `delete "members" => "groups#remove_member"` and `put "members" => "groups#add_members"` are written directly inside the `resources :groups` block (not inside a `collection do`), so Rails treats them as member routes at `/admin/groups/:id/members` and only populates `params[:id]`. However, `Admin::GroupsController#add_members` (line 66) and `#remove_member` (line 85) both call `params.require(:group_id).to_i`, so every real browser request will raise `ActionController::ParameterMissing: param is missing or the value is empty: group_id`. The RSpec tests pass only because the test invocation explicitly passes `group_id:` in the params hash, masking the bug. Fix either by moving the routes into a `collection do` block (so `group_id` is a query param) or by changing the controller to use `params[:id]`.

findings.title: add_members does not strip whitespace from split usernames
findings.body: `usernames.split(",")` yields entries like `" bob"` when a user types `"alice, bob"`, and `User.find_by_username(" bob")` returns nil (the DB stores usernames without surrounding whitespace), so the second user silently fails to be added. Strip each entry, e.g. `username.strip`, before looking the user up, and skip blanks. The existing happy-path spec uses `.join(",")` with no space, which is why this regression is not caught.

findings.title: remove_member test sends PUT instead of DELETE
findings.body: The spec at line 115 uses `xhr :put, :remove_member, group_id: 1, user_id: 42`, but the `remove_member` action is now routed via `delete "members"` in `config/routes.rb`. The test should use `xhr :delete, :remove_member, ...` (mirroring the working "is able to remove a member" test below it). With the wrong verb the test either hits the wrong action or fails to route, and it does not exercise the DELETE branch at all.

findings.title: Missing semicolon at end of addMembers
findings.body: The `addMembers` function body ends with `})` on line 59 (closing the `.then` callback and the `Discourse.ajax` call) without a trailing semicolon. Every other method in the same file terminates statements with semicolons, so this is inconsistent and relies on ASI; it is a one-character fix.
